name: Snoqualmie Ridge (Cascade foothill forest, Snoqualmie WA)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json), made against the NAIP photo of the course (2026-11-13). The Club at Snoqualmie Ridge sits on a forested plateau at the foot of the Cascades, under Mount Si: holes cut through dark second-growth Douglas fir and hemlock, the rough a deep wet-side green (darker and bluer than pnw), the off-course clearings and lawns of the ridge's housing a duller olive green (L0-L2) so out of bounds reads apart; very white bunker sand, as on Nicklaus courses; slate-blue ponds and wetlands; grey basalt and stucco. Trees: Douglas fir and western red cedar, bigleaf maple and red alder (assets-src/trees_snoqualmie_ridge.py). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
